fields.summary: Autonomous plan run for change set 01M6NR6E: on 2026-11-05 the VM's ~/.cache/go-build reached 47G and stale go-build* temp folders piled up in TMPDIR. With no owner present, the planner raised one question (intent, trigger, scope) to the arbiter. The arbiter ruled in Decision go-cache-sweep-shape: the change set serves milestone-25 (the backlog). The daemon sweeps when it starts, then hourly, and also at once when free space drops under 2x rhiza.daemon.minFree, at most once every 10 minutes. A sweep removes Go build cache entries with an mtime over 3 hours old and go-build* folders directly under os.TempDir() with an mtime over 2 hours old. The cache is $GOCACHE, or os.UserCacheDir()/go-build when GOCACHE is unset; GOCACHE=off skips the cache. A new setting, rhiza.daemon.trimGoCache (default on), turns the sweep off. One stderr line reports what was freed, only when something was. Two leaves were planned: the sweep itself and the daemon's schedule and setting for it. Nothing is left open.
fields.title: Planning the daemon's Go build cache sweep (autonomous)
